edges.reason: Constructor parameter _governance is written into the governance state variable.
Constructor parameter _rewardToken is written into the rewardToken state variable.
Constructor parameter _reward is written into the reward state variable.
Constructor parameter _idTreshold is written into the idTreshold state variable.
setReward writes the caller-supplied _newReward into the reward state variable.
setGovernance writes the caller-supplied _newGovernance into the governance state variable.
msg.sender becomes the initial _owner during construction.
msg.sender is compared against the decoded proposer and is the reward recipient.
pid is used as the key to read and set the rewardedPropolsals mapping.
idTreshold participates in require(pid > idTreshold) which gates the reward flow.
rewardedPropolsals[pid] gates execution via require(!rewardedPropolsals[pid]).
pid is ABI-encoded into the payload local variable.
governance address is the target of the raw low-level call.
payload is the calldata supplied to address(governance).call.
success flag is the first return value of the low-level call.
returnData bytes are the second return value of the low-level call.
proposer is decoded from returnData through assembly mload.
executed is decoded from returnData through assembly mload.
require(proposer == msg.sender) restricts the reward to the proposal creator.
require(executed) gates the payout on the decoded execution flag.
require(success) reverts the reward flow when the governance call fails.
rewardToken address is the ERC20 contract used for the reward transfer.
reward amount is the value passed to the ERC20 transfer.
msg.sender is the recipient of the reward transfer.
rewardToken address is the ERC20 contract used for the leftover transfer.
_to is the destination of the leftover balance transfer.
_owner is compared with msg.sender inside the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender is compared with _owner in the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner restricts who may call setReward.
onlyOwner restricts who may call setGovernance.
onlyOwner restricts who may call withdrawLeftovers.
onlyOwner restricts who may call transferOwnership.
newOwner must be non-zero and is written into the _owner state variable.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership sets the _owner state variable to address(0).
withdrawLeftovers performs the ERC20 balance transfer.
getPropolsalReward executes the reward token transfer to msg.sender.
getPropolsalReward makes an external low-level call to the governance contract, which can re-enter while the reward is still pending.
ERC20 transfer to msg.sender is an external call executed before the function returns, allowing re-entrant reward claiming for other proposal ids.
withdrawLeftovers pushes tokens to an arbitrary _to address which can re-enter the reward logic.

normalization_plan.reason: _governance is a constructor-only parameter that is immediately folded into the constructor's state initialization.
_rewardToken is a constructor-only parameter consumed by the constructor assignment.
_reward is a constructor-only parameter consumed by the constructor assignment.
_idTreshold is a constructor-only parameter consumed by the constructor assignment.
_newReward is the exclusive input of setReward and has no independent semantics.
_newGovernance is the exclusive input of setGovernance and has no independent semantics.
_to is only used as the destination inside withdrawLeftovers.
pid only exists as the proposal identifier processed by getPropolsalReward.
newOwner is only used inside transferOwnership.
payload exists solely as calldata for the raw governance call.
success is only the boolean outcome of the governance low-level call.
returnData is only the raw buffer produced by the governance low-level call.
proposer is a decoded temporary used solely in the access check of getPropolsalReward.
executed is a decoded temporary used solely in the execution check of getPropolsalReward.
